about.title: About Kashiro

about.licence: Kashiro is free software under the Apache License 2.0.
about.noticesHint: Credits and licences of the data, fonts and libraries included in Kashiro. They are in English.
settings.title: Settings
settings.trackedLabel: Tracked changes: your reviewer can accept or reject each change in Word (otherwise a clean copy)
settings.overwriteLabel: Overwrite the original (keeps a .bak backup) instead of saving a new copy
settings.termRepeats: Treat an unknown lowercase word as a term once it is used
settings.autoApply: Also list these on the simple fixes
settings.autoApplyHint: Their fixes are listed on the simple-fixes card, unticked: tick the ones you want before you apply. Never touches names, numbers, quotes or other protected text.
settings.ignoredEmpty: Kinds of suggestion you dismiss with Dismiss ▾ › “All … suggestions everywhere” show up here.
settings.dictionaryEmpty: Words you add while reviewing show up here.
reading.noVoice: No voice that works offline is installed, so Read aloud is hidden. To add one: Windows Settings › Time & language › Speech › Add voices.
reading.voiceNote: Only voices installed on this PC are used, so your text is never sent anywhere.

modules.alwaysOn: Spelling and grammar rules, and the protection of names, numbers, quotes and code, are always on.
modules.namesCardDescription: Groups names and places into one card you add in one go.
modules.termsCardDescription: Groups words you repeat (“ferrocement”) into one card.
modules.otherLanguageCardDescription: Groups romanised Hindi, Bengali, Tamil and other Indian-language words into one card you add in one go.
modules.otherLanguageCardCost: No extra memory. Off, each word is its own decision. Either way, your spelling of such words is never auto-changed.
modules.betterSuggestionsDescription: Puts the likeliest word first and adds common words the spell checker missed.
modules.betterSuggestionsCost: Uses the word list the app always has: no extra memory.
modules.wordLookupDescription: Meanings and synonyms from an offline dictionary.
modules.wordLookupCost: About {memory, number} MB of memory once you look up a word ({data, number} MB of data).
modules.aiRewritesDescription: A writing helper on this computer suggests smoother sentences. Never applied without your click.
modules.aiRewritesCost: A {min, number}–{max, number} GB model, and as much memory while it runs.
modules.unknownModel: Unknown model; use at your own risk
modules.modelHint: A .gguf file on this computer. The app never downloads models.
explain.oneWord: Did you mean “{word}”, as one word?
explain.notCounted: “{word}” is not usually counted, so it takes no plural and no “a”.
explain.noPlural: “{word}” is not usually counted, so it takes no plural.
explain.aOrAn: Use “a” before a consonant sound and “an” before a vowel sound.
explain.linkingWord: A small linking word such as “to”, “of” or “in” may be missing here.
explain.pronouns: Too many words like “I”, “you” or “they” in a row here.
explain.howOften: “{first}” and “{second}” both say how often: keep one.
explain.oneOfThe: After “one of the”, use the plural (“one of the books”).
explain.twoWords: If “{word}” is an action here, write it as two words.
explain.toToo: Use “to” here: “too” means “also” or “more than enough”.
explain.verbMatchesWord: Make the verb match the word before it (“he walks”, “they walk”).
explain.verbMatchesSubject: Make the verb match its subject (“he walks”, “they walk”).
explain.its: Use “its” (no apostrophe) for ownership. “It’s” means “it is” or “it has”.
explain.contraction: Contraction in formal writing; consider the full form.
explain.caste: A social group is a “caste”; “cast” is the actors in a film or play.
explain.lose: To no longer have something is to “lose” it; “loose” means not tight.
explain.onCall: In English you are “on a call”, not “in call”.
explain.directionKept: Invisible direction character ({code} {name}). Kashiro leaves it in place: removing it on its own could change how the text around it is shown.
explain.simpleFixes: Only repeated words start ticked. Every other fix, including the kinds you chose in Settings, starts unticked: tick the ones you want. Nothing changes until you apply them.
explain.rewrite: Suggested rewrite of the sentence. Check the meaning before accepting.

error.unsupported: Can’t open {name}: Kashiro opens .docx, .txt and .md files. Save it in one of those formats, then open it again.
error.openNext: Check that the file opens in Word or a text editor, then try again.
error.file.damaged: Can’t open {name}: the file is damaged or incomplete. If it was copied or downloaded, get a fresh copy, or open it in Word and save it again.
error.file.notWord: Can’t open {name}: it isn’t a Word document, although its name ends in .docx. Open it in the program that made it and save it as .docx, .txt or .md.
error.file.encrypted: Can’t open {name}: it is protected with a password. In Word, remove the password (File › Info › Protect Document › Encrypt with Password), save it, then open it again.
error.file.oldWord: Can’t open {name}: it is an older Word file (.doc) with a .docx name. Open it in Word, choose File › Save As › Word Document (.docx), then open the new file.
error.file.notUtf8: Can’t open {name}: the text isn’t saved as UTF-8. Open it in Notepad, choose File › Save As, set Encoding to UTF-8, save, then open it again.
error.file.utf16: Can’t open {name}: the text is saved as UTF-16 (Unicode). Open it in Notepad, choose File › Save As, set Encoding to UTF-8, save, then open it again.
error.file.binary: Can’t open {name}: it isn’t a text file, although its name ends in .txt or .md. Choose the document itself instead.
error.file.empty: {name} is empty: there’s no text to check. Choose another file, or paste some text.
error.file.tooLong: {name} is too long to check in one go ({words, number} words; the limit is {limit, number} words). Split it into smaller files and check each one.
error.file.tooLarge: {name} is too large to check ({megabytes, number} MB; text files can be up to {limit, number} MB). Split it into smaller files and check each one.
error.file.paragraphTooLong: {name} has a paragraph too long to check ({characters, number} characters; the limit is {limit, number}). Break it into shorter paragraphs; in a text file, put a blank line between them.
error.typed: The typed text could not be checked
error.typedNext: Keep typing to try again, or save and reopen the file.
error.checkNext: Edit the text or reopen the file to try again.
error.checkNextNotSaved: Nothing can be saved until the text is checked: edit the text to try again. If it keeps failing, copy your text somewhere safe, then close the document. Your file on disk is unchanged.
error.settingsSaveNext: They apply until you close the app; change one again to retry saving.
error.helperStop: The writing helper did not stop
error.helperStopNext: Restart the app to stop it.
error.model: The model file could not be checked
error.modelNext: Choose the file again, or pick another .gguf file.
error.saveAgain: Close the file if another program has it open, or choose another folder, then save again.
error.saveOverOriginal: Not saved: {name} is the document you opened, and a copy never replaces it. Choose another name, or turn on “Overwrite (keeps a backup)” in Save options.
error.saveNotChecked: Not saved: the text changed after its last check, so your changes could land in the wrong places. Edit the text to check it again, then save. If the check keeps failing, copy your text somewhere safe, then close the document. Your file on disk is unchanged.
error.checkerStartNext: Restart the app. If it happens again, reinstall it.
error.dropNext: Use Open (Ctrl+O) to pick it instead.
